zebraStriped.description:
Whether to have the rows of the grid zebra striped.

Default value is false, i.e. not zebra striped.

rowBorder.description:
Config for the border around the cells of the grid.

`free` has no borders in the grid.

`division` has border under each row in the grid.

`grid` has border around each cell in the grid.

rowSize.description: Config for the size of each row in the grid.

title: Configuration type for the rows of the {@link UiSdlDataGrid} component.
name: UiSdlDataGridRowConfig
